summary: Issue label-check accepts the `Spike` type label shipped in labels.yml and allows AGENTS.md status:* exceptions (`status:stub`, `status:blocked`, `status:ready-to-work`, `status:implemented`) while still rejecting `priority:*` and other status labels (#1262 items 1–2).
migration_impact: Import or merge updated `label-check.yml` from plate-core; Spike and status stub issues stop failing the workflow.
migration_guidance: Manually merge the label-check.yml changes from plate-core into your repo: add `Spike` to `issueTypeLabels` and replace the blanket `status:|priority:` filter with `allowedStatusLabels` plus a `priority:*` check (see upstream `.github/workflows/label-check.yml`).
Ensure `.github/labels.yml` includes Spike before creating Spike issues.
agent_notes: Repo and template_payload copies stay identical; contract test in test_native_github_pr_integration.py.
